explanation: Players scoop up all the seeds in one pit and sow them one by one into the pits that follow, capturing by count. Similar games are played from Africa to Southeast Asia.

claims.text: Oware is a game of the mancala family of 'sowing' games, widely played in West Africa.
Oware is not a morris, tables or draughts game.
In mancala games a player lifts all the seeds from one pit and sows them one at a time into the following pits, capturing according to the count.
Mancala games are played across Africa and in parts of Asia, including Southeast Asia.
